messages:
sofia: Just finished boot of ap-south-2 cluster (8xA100 nodes). Need a quick perf validation runbook: kernel/driver checks, p95 latency sweep, throughput baselining. Starting smoke now.
raj: Can you paste the checklist? I can run kernel/driver validation and driver versions.
ben: Checklist below — running now:
- verify nvidia driver: `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=driver_version --format=csv,noheader`
- nv_peer_mem & nvidia-uvm loaded: `lsmod | egrep "nvidia|nv_peer_mem|nvidia_uvm"`
- check MIG config (if used): `nvidia-smi mig -l`
- dmesg grep NVIDIA / var/log/kern.log for X errors

ben: also running kernel module check:
```
ssh node-01 'sudo modinfo nvidia | head -n 20'
ssh node-01 'sudo ethtool -k eth0'
```

maria-ml: For throughput baselining, run the micro-bench harness with these profiles:
- short: seq_len=128 batch=1..8
- medium: seq_len=512 batch=1..4
- long: seq_len=2048 batch=1
Command we use:
```
./bench/gpt_infer --model /models/galactica-8b --seq 512 --batch 2 --iters 200 --device gpu
```
Log format -> tokens/s and p95 latency per request.

chris: FYI saw weird p95 spikes earlier — check NIC offload and MTU mismatch. Run:
```
ip link show | grep mtu
sudo ethtool -k eth0 | egrep 'scatter|gso|tso'
```
If GSO/TX offload disabled on one side can add 500-1000us per packet. Also watch for IRQ balancing: `cat /proc/interrupts | grep eth0`.

sofia: Running those now. Quick results: driver 525.85.12, nvidia_uvm present, no obvious dmesg OOPS. GSO/TX on.

ben: Good. Next: kernel settings for hugepages and swappiness — set vm.swappiness=10 and reserve hugepages if using hugepage allocator. Also check clocksource: `cat /sys/devices/system/clocksource/clocksource0/current_clocksource` should be tsc.

maria-ml: Added throughput targets to the runbook: short>=120k tokens/s, medium>=45k tokens/s, long>=9k tokens/s for 8xA100 baseline. Log results to s3://redwood-perf/ap-south-2/<run-id>/

sofia: First micro-bench done. short=128k tokens/s, p95=8.3ms, medium=46k tokens/s, p95=12.7ms, long=10.1k tokens/s. All within targets except medium p95 slightly high.

chris: Medium p95 looking high could be tail from inter-node networking — were requests crossing hosts? Check placement and batching policy. Maybe PV cache warmup needed.

raj: I reran with intra-node pinned: pinned pods to GPU nodes with `nodeSelector` and added `NET_PRIO=high` env. p95 dropped to 10.5ms. Suggest adding to runbook: pin benchmark pods to avoid cross-node noise.

sofia: Noted. Action items:
- ben: add kernel & ethtool checks to bootstrap script
- raj: add pod affinity to perf job template
- maria-ml: add run-id naming + S3 upload steps
- chris: write NIC checklist for oncall

oncall-bot: Created ticket PERF-AP2-42 and assigned to infra oncall.

ben: I'll draft the runbook section and push to infra/runbooks/ap-south-2/perf-validation.md. Will include exact commands and expected output snippets.

maria-ml: Also recommend recording a short recording of the p95 spike with `perf top` or `bpftrace` to capture kernel-side stack during a spike.

sofia: Thanks all — will run one more end-to-end and then handoff to SRE. :thumbsup:
